cmd.drawing.to_detail.desc: Turns the picked drawing primitives, or the whole drawing on this level, into detail lines, text notes and regions on the plan. The drawing stays as it is.
detail_items.st.nothing: Nothing to convert: no lines, arcs, texts or fills on shown layers
detail_items.st.done: Detail items added: lines {lines}, texts {texts}, regions {regions}
detail_items.st.warn: Detail items added, but the view could not be refreshed (lines {lines}, texts {texts}, regions {regions}): {e}. Undo removes them.
detail_items.st.bad_view: Detail items need a plan or section view
detail_items.st.no_transform: This view has no usable coordinate system for the drawing; nothing was added
drafting_tools.free.plan_only: This command works on plan elements; open a plan
drafting_tools.free.zero: The two points coincide; nothing was added
drafting_tools.free.select_first: Select the items of this view to distribute first
drafting_tools.free.pick_item: Click an item of this view to tag it
drafting_tools.free.dim_kind: Only linear dimensions work in a drafting view
